codanā hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭam ity evaṃjātīyakam arthaṃ śaknoty avagamayituṃ nānyat kiṃcanendriyam bhūtaṃ+bhavantaṃ · codanā hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭam ity evaṃjātīyakam arthaṃ śaknoty avagamayituṃ nānyat kiṃcanendriyam bhavantaṃ+bhaviṣyantaṃ · bravītīty ucyate 'vabodhayati budhyamānasya nimittaṃ bhavatīti nimittaṃ+bhavati · nanu sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati dṛṣṭaṃ+bhaviṣyati

tathā hi prasiddhapadārthakaḥ sa kalpito bhavati kalpito+bhavati · yadi ca codanāyāṃ satyām agnihotrāt svargo bhavatīty avagamyate katham ucyate na tathā bhavatīti svargo+bhavati · prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam mano+bhavati · na ca mithyaitad iti kālāntare deśāntare 'vasthāntare puruṣāntare vā punar avyapadeśyaḥ pratyayo bhavati pratyayo+bhavati

acetayan eva hi suṣupta ity ucyate ity+ucyate · utpadyamānaivāsau jñāyate jñāpayati cārthāntaraṃ pradīpavad iti yady ucyeta tan na yady+ucyeta · nanūtpannāyām eva buddhāv artho jñāta ity ucyate nānutpannāyām ity+ucyate · nanu utpannāyām eva buddhāv artho jñāta ity ucyate nānutpannāyām ity+ucyate

na hy etad ekaṃ vākyaṃ purastāc ca vedādhyayanād dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhiṣyati parastāc cānantaryaṃ prakariṣyati purastāc+ca · na hy etad ekaṃ vākyaṃ purastāc ca vedādhyayanād dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhiṣyati parastāc cānantaryaṃ prakariṣyati parastāc+ca · arthaikatvāc caikavākyatāṃ vakṣyati ekatvāt→arthaikatvāc +ca · kiṃ tv adhīte vede dvayam āpatati gurukulāc ca samāvartitavyaṃ vedavākyāni ca vicārayitavyāni kulāt→gurukulāc +ca

tasmād yasya ca duṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ yatra ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ sa evāsamīcīnaḥ pratyayo nānya iti karaṇaṃ+yatra · syād etad evaṃ yady arthākārā buddhiḥ syāt evaṃ+yady · tatra pratyakṣatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ yathā dhūmākṛtidarśanād agnyākṛtivijñānam saṃbandham→pratyakṣatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ +yathā · pātracayanaṃ vidhāyāha sa eṣa yajñāyudhī yajamāno 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokaṃ yātīti pratyakṣaṃ śarīraṃ vyapadiśati lokaṃ+yāti

evaṃ hi vedavākyāny evaibhir vyākhyāyante evaṃ+hi · evaṃ hi samāmananti vedam adhītya snāyād iti evaṃ+hi · pūrvakālatāyāṃ hi ktvā smaryate nānantarye tāyām→pūrvakālatāyāṃ +hi · evam adhīto vedo dharmajijñāsāyāṃ hetur jñāto 'nantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity ataḥśabdasya sāmarthyam jijñāsāyām→dharmajijñāsāyāṃ +hetur

prabuddho hy avagacchati nidrākrāntaṃ me mana āsīd iti mana+āsīd · pauruṣeye hi sati saṃbandhe yaḥ pratyayas tasya mithyābhāva āśaṅkyeta bhāvaḥ→mithyābhāva +āśaṅkyeta · na hi vṛddhiśabdenāpāṇiner vyavahārata ādaicaḥ pratīyeran pāṇinikṛtim ananumanyamānasya vā vyavahārata+āt · te 'pi vṛddhā yadā bālā āsaṃs tadānyebhyo vṛddhebhyas te 'py anyebhya iti nāsty ādir ity evaṃ vā bhavet bālā+āsaṃs

tāni dharmāṇi prathamāny āsan prathamāny+āsan · tatra pratyakṣatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ yathā dhūmākṛtidarśanād agnyākṛtivijñānam agni+ākṛti→agnyākṛtivijñānam · te 'pi vṛddhā yadā bālā āsaṃs tadānyebhyo vṛddhebhyas te 'py anyebhya iti nāsty ādir ity evaṃ vā bhavet asti→nāsty +ādir · bahavaḥ khalv iha janā asty ātmāsty ātmety ātmasattāvādina eva śabdasya pratyakṣavaktāro bhavanti tathāpi nātmasattāṃ kalpayituṃ ghaṭante kim aṅga punar jānātīti parokṣaśabdadarśanāt asty+ātmā

kathaṃ duṣṭāduṣṭāvagama iti cet prayatnenānvicchanto na ced doṣam upalabhemahi pramāṇābhāvād aduṣṭam iti manyemahi kathaṃ+duṣṭa · sāmānyatodṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ ca yathā devadattasya gatipūrvikāṃ deśāntaraprāptim upalabhyāditye 'pi gatismaraṇam pūrvikām→gatipūrvikāṃ +deśa · kālāntare phalaṃ dāsyatīti cen na na kālāntare phalam iṣṭer ity avagacchāmaḥ phalaṃ+dāsyati · asatī ca kathaṃ dāsyaty api ca karmakāla eva phalaṃ śrūyate yāgaḥ karaṇam iti vākyād avagamyate karaṇaṃ ced utpannaṃ kāryeṇa bhavitavyam iti kathaṃ+dāsyaty

sa cet prasiddho na jijñāsyaḥ cet+prasiddho · yat tu laukikaṃ vacanaṃ tac cet pratyayitāt puruṣād indriyaviṣayaṃ vāvitatham eva tat cet+pratyayitāt · viplavate khalv api kaścit puruṣakṛtād vacanāt pratyayaḥ kaścit+puruṣa · kathaṃ duṣṭāduṣṭāvagama iti cet prayatnenānvicchanto na ced doṣam upalabhemahi pramāṇābhāvād aduṣṭam iti manyemahi cet+prayatnena

dṛṣṭo hi tasyārthaḥ karmāvabodhanaṃ nāma dṛṣṭo+hi · ataḥśabdo vṛttasyāpadeśako hetvarthena yathā kṣemasubhikṣo 'yaṃ deśo 'to 'ham asmin deśe prativasāmīti apadeśakaḥ→vṛttasyāpadeśako +hetu · yo hi janitvā pradhvaṃsate naitad evam iti sa mithyāpratyayaḥ yo+hi · ucyata upadeśo hi vyāmohād api bhavati upadeśo+hi

na ca niścitam avagamyamānam idaṃ mithyā syāt idaṃ+mithyā · pauruṣeyaṃ vacanaṃ vitatham upalabhya vacanasāmānyād vedavacanaṃ mithyety anumīyate vacanam→vedavacanaṃ +mithyā · bādarāyaṇasyedaṃ mataṃ kīrtyate bādarāyaṇaṃ pūjayituṃ nātmīyaṃ mataṃ paryudasitum ātmīyam→nātmīyaṃ +mataṃ · kathaṃ jñāyate yadā hi śuktikāyām api rajataṃ manyamāno rajatasaṃnikṛṣṭaṃ me cakṣur iti manyate bādhakaṃ hi yatra jñānam utpadyate naitad evaṃ mithyājñānam idam iti tad anyasaṃprayoge viparītaṃ tatsaṃprayoga iti rajataṃ+manyamāno

tatrānartho dharma ukto mā bhūd ity arthagrahaṇam dharma+ukto · utpattir hi bhāva ucyate lakṣaṇayā bhāva+ucyate · pratyayasya hi nirālambanatā svabhāva upalakṣitaḥ svapne svabhāva+upalakṣitaḥ · na ca paśukāmeṣṭyanantaraṃ paśava upalabhyante paśava+upalabhyante

asatī ca kathaṃ dāsyaty api ca karmakāla eva phalaṃ śrūyate yāgaḥ karaṇam iti vākyād avagamyate karaṇaṃ ced utpannaṃ kāryeṇa bhavitavyam iti kāle→karmakāla +eva · asaty apy arthāntara evaṃjātīyake bhavati pratyayaḥ paṅktir yūthaṃ vanam iti yatheti cen na antare→arthāntara +evaṃjātīyake · atha kaṃcit kalpayitvā na saṃbandhyantaram api kalpayiṣyasi tāvaty eva viraṃsyasi tāvatā ca paritokṣyasi tato vijñāna eva parituṣya tāvaty eva virantum arhasi vijñāna+eva · yathā ca kaścic cakṣuṣmān svayaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati na ca śaknoty anyasmai jātyandhāya tan nidarśayituṃ na ca tan na śakyate nidarśayitum ity etāvatā nāstīty avagamyata evam asau puruṣaḥ svayam ātmānam upalabhate na cānyasmai śaknoti darśayitum anyasya draṣṭus taṃ puruṣaṃ prati darśanaśaktyabhāvāt avagamyata+evam

ucyate tādṛśīṃ tu dharmajijñāsām adhikṛtyāthaśabdaṃ prayuktavān ācāryo yā vedādhyayanam antareṇa na sambhavati ācāryo+yā · na ca tasyādhyayanamātrāt tatrabhavanto yājñikāḥ phalaṃ samāmananti tatrabhavanto+yājñikāḥ · na ca svargakāmo yajetety ato vacanāt saṃdigdham avagamyate bhavati vā svargo na vā bhavatīti kāmaḥ→svargakāmo +yajeta · prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam viśeṣo+yadā

evaṃ hi vedavākyāny evaibhir vyākhyāyante ebhiḥ→evaibhir +vyākhyāyante · kiṃ tu lakṣaṇayāsnānādiniyamasya paryavasānaṃ vedādhyayanasamakālam āhur vedam adhītya snāyād gurukulān mā samāvartiṣṭety adṛṣṭārthatāparihārāyaiva āhur+vedam · buddhir vā janma vā saṃnikarṣo veti naiṣāṃ kasyacid avadhāraṇārtham etat sūtram buddhir+vā · prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam ādibhiḥ→saukṣmyādibhir +vā

tatra loke 'yam athaśabdo vṛttād anantarasya prakriyārtho dṛṣṭaḥ arthaḥ→prakriyārtho +dṛṣṭaḥ · tadantargato doṣo mithyājñānasya hetuḥ antargataḥ→tadantargato +doṣo · sanidrasya manaso daurbalyān nidrā mithyābhāvasya hetuḥ svapnādau svapnānte ca manaso+daurbalyān · arthāpattir api dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vārtho 'nyathā nopapadyata ity arthakalpanā yathā jīvato devadattasya gṛhābhāvadarśanena bahirbhāvasya adṛṣṭasya kalpanā jīvato+devadattasya

nanu ca śāstrakārā apy evam āhuḥ pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvam ākhyāte nācaṣṭe vrajati pacatīty upakramaprabhṛty apavargaparyantam iti yathā kārāḥ→śāstrakārā +apy · kim asati vane vanapratyayo bhavatīti pratyakṣam eva ākṣipyate vṛkṣā api na santīti yady evaṃ pratyuktaḥ sa māhāyānikaḥ pakṣaḥ vṛkṣā+api · tasmād avaśyam anena saṃbandhaṃ kurvatā akṛtasaṃbandhāḥ kecana śabdā vṛddhavyavahārasiddhā abhyupagantavyāḥ siddhāḥ→vṛddhavyavahārasiddhā +abhyupagantavyāḥ · bahavaḥ khalv iha janā asty ātmāsty ātmety ātmasattāvādina eva śabdasya pratyakṣavaktāro bhavanti tathāpi nātmasattāṃ kalpayituṃ ghaṭante kim aṅga punar jānātīti parokṣaśabdadarśanāt janā+asty

syād etat saṃbandhamātravyavahāriṇo niṣprayojanaṃ kartṛsmaraṇam anādriyamāṇāḥ puruṣā vismareyur iti puruṣā+vismareyur · tasmād avaśyam anena saṃbandhaṃ kurvatā akṛtasaṃbandhāḥ kecana śabdā vṛddhavyavahārasiddhā abhyupagantavyāḥ śabdā+vṛddha · dṛṣṭā hi bālā vṛddhebhyaḥ pratipadyamānā na tv apratipannasaṃbandhāḥ saṃbandhasya kartuḥ bālā+vṛddhebhyaḥ · yasya punaḥ kurvanti tasya vāyavīyāḥ saṃyogavibhāgā vāyvāśritatvād vāyuṣv eva kariṣyanti yathā tantavas tantuṣv eva paṭam vibhāgāḥ→saṃyogavibhāgā +vāyu

tatra gurukulān mā samāvartiṣṭa kathaṃ nu vedavākyāni vicārayed ity evamartho 'yam upadeśaḥ arthaḥ+'yam · tasmāc codanālakṣaṇo 'rthaḥ śreyaskaraḥ lakṣaṇaḥ+'rthaḥ · ucyate yatra vākyād evārtho 'vagamyate tatraivam arthaḥ+'vagamyate · arthāpattir api dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vārtho 'nyathā nopapadyata ity arthakalpanā yathā jīvato devadattasya gṛhābhāvadarśanena bahirbhāvasya adṛṣṭasya kalpanā arthaḥ+'nyathā

tad yatnagauravaṃ prasajyeta tad+yatna · tasmād yasya ca duṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ yatra ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ sa evāsamīcīnaḥ pratyayo nānya iti tasmād+yasya · nanu jāgrato 'pi karaṇadoṣaḥ syād yadi syād avagamyeta syād+yadi · bhavati hi kadācid etad yaj jñāto 'rthaḥ so 'jñāta ity ucyate etad+yaj

vṛttikāras tv anyathemaṃ granthaṃ varṇayāṃcakāra tasya nimittaparīṣṭir ity evamādiṃ na parīkṣitavyaṃ nimittam imam→anyathemaṃ +granthaṃ · upamānam api sādṛśyam asaṃnikṛṣṭe 'rthe buddhim utpādayati yathā gavayadarśanaṃ gosmaraṇasya darśanam→gavayadarśanaṃ +go · yadi śrotraṃ saṃyogavibhāgadeśam āgatya śabdaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tathāpi tāvad anekadeśatā kadācid avagamyeta śabdaṃ+gṛhṇīyāt · athedānīṃ padārthā avagatāḥ santo vākyārthaṃ gamayanti artham→vākyārthaṃ +gamayanti

nanv atathābhūtam apy arthaṃ brūyāc codanā yathā yatkiṃcana laukikaṃ vacanaṃ nadyās tīre phalāni santīti arthaṃ+brūyāc · kiṃ kāraṇam evaṃlakṣaṇakaṃ hi tat satsaṃprayoge puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ buddhijanma tat pratyakṣam indriyāṇām→puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ +buddhi · autpattika iti nityaṃ brūmaḥ nityaṃ+brūmaḥ · tatsaṃprayoge puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ buddhijanma sat pratyakṣam indriyāṇām→puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ +buddhi

nādhyāhārādibhir eṣāṃ parikalpanīyo 'rthaḥ paribhāṣitavyo vā ādibhiḥ→nādhyāhārādibhir +eṣāṃ · tatra bhinnayor eva vākyayor imāv ekadeśāv ity avagantavyam bhinnayor+eva · api ca kāmam ekarūpatve buddher evābhāvo na tv arthasya pratyakṣasya sataḥ buddher+eva · nanu prāṇādibhir enam upalabhāmahe ādibhiḥ→prāṇādibhir +enam

anyā hi vacanavyaktir asya purastād vedādhyayanād dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhato 'nyā ca parastād ānantaryam upadiśataḥ parastād+ānantaryam · na ca himavadādiṣu kūpārāmādivad asmaraṇaṃ bhavitum arhati himavat+ādiṣu→himavadādiṣu · atra vṛddhavyavahāre sati nārthād āpadyeta saṃbandhasya kartā arthāt→nārthād +āpadyeta · ucyate prāṅmukho devadattaḥ pūrvāhne saṃprati purastād ādityaṃ paśyati purastād+ādityaṃ

iha ca vedam adhītya snāsyan dharmaṃ jijñāsamāna imam āmnāyam atikrāmet dharmaṃ+jijñāsamāna · ata etasmāt kāraṇād anantaraṃ dharmaṃ jijñāsitum icched ity ataḥśabdasyārthaḥ dharmaṃ+jijñāsitum · sa punaḥ kathaṃ jijñāsitavyaḥ ko dharmaḥ kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ kāny asya sādhanāni kāni sādhanābhāsāni kiṃparaś ceti kathaṃ+jijñāsitavyaḥ · na hi tad utpannaṃ jñānaṃ viparyeti utpannaṃ+jñānaṃ

lakṣaṇayā tv eṣo 'rthaḥ syāt tv+eṣo · api ca niyatanimittas tantuṣv evopādīyamāneṣu paṭapratyayaḥ tantuṣv+eva · nanv evam api śabdād arthaṃ pratipadyāmaha iti laukikaṃ vacanam anupapannaṃ syāt nanv+evam · yasya punaḥ kurvanti tasya vāyavīyāḥ saṃyogavibhāgā vāyvāśritatvād vāyuṣv eva kariṣyanti yathā tantavas tantuṣv eva paṭam vāyuṣv+eva

idānīṃ tasya nimittaṃ parīkṣiṣyāmahe kiṃ codanaivotānyad apīti codanā+eva→codanaivotānyad · yac ca nāma jñānam utpannaṃ na viparyeti na tac chakyate vaktuṃ naitad evam iti yathā vijñāyate na tathā bhavati yathaitan na vijñāyate tathaitad iti yathā+etat→yathaitan · yac ca nāma jñānam utpannaṃ na viparyeti na tac chakyate vaktuṃ naitad evam iti yathā vijñāyate na tathā bhavati yathaitan na vijñāyate tathaitad iti tathā+etat→tathaitad · utpadyamānaivāsau jñāyate jñāpayati cārthāntaraṃ pradīpavad iti yady ucyeta tan na utpadyamānā+eva→utpadyamānaivāsau

prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam ādibhiḥ→kṣudādibhir +upahataṃ · ataḥ pūrvaṃ buddhir utpadyate paścāj jñāto 'rthaḥ buddhir+utpadyate · ataḥ pūrvaṃ buddhir utpadyate paścāj jñāto 'rthaḥ buddhir+utpadyate · pūrvaṃ buddhir utpadyate na tu pūrvaṃ jñāyate buddhir+utpadyate
ato na vyabhicarati pratyakṣam ato+na · ato neṣṭiḥ paśuphalā ato+na · ato nāsti saṃbandhā ato+na · ato na śarīraguṇāḥ prāṇādayaḥ ato+na

atha pratītis tathābhāvasya hetur na śakyate pratyayād ayaṃ anya iti vaditum hetur+na · arthaviṣayā hi pratyakṣabuddhir na buddhyantaraviṣayā buddhiḥ→pratyakṣabuddhir +na · asti ced vyavahārasiddhir na niyogataḥ saṃbandhrā bhavitavyam ity arthāpattir api nāsti siddhiḥ→vyavahārasiddhir +na · tena sarve svena svenātmanā ātmānam upalabhamānāḥ santy eva yady api parapuruṣair nopalabhyanta iti puruṣaiḥ→parapuruṣair +na

na tatra kaścid viśeṣa iti cen na svapne viparyayadarśanād aviparyayāc cetarasmin cen+na · kālāntare phalaṃ dāsyatīti cen na na kālāntare phalam iṣṭer ity avagacchāmaḥ cen+na · śabde cen nimittabhūte svayam avabudhyate kathaṃ vipralabdhaṃ brūyān naitad evam iti cen+nimitta · antarhite 'pi śabde smaraṇād arthapratyaya iti cen na cen+na

prabuddho hy avagacchati nidrākrāntaṃ me mana āsīd iti nidrā+ākrāntam→nidrākrāntaṃ · gaur itīmaṃ śabdam uccārayanti sāsnādimantam artham avabudhyanta iti sāsnā+ādimantam→sāsnādimantam · atha gaur ity asya śabdasya ko 'rthaḥ sāsnādiviśiṣṭākṛtir iti brūmaḥ sāsnā+ādi→sāsnādiviśiṣṭākṛtir · ucyata icchayātmānam upalabhāmahe icchayā+ātmānam→icchayātmānam

yadi ca codanāyāṃ satyām agnihotrāt svargo bhavatīty avagamyate katham ucyate na tathā bhavatīti iti→bhavatīty +avagamyate · abhāvo 'pi pramāṇābhāvo nāstīty asyārthasyāsaṃnikṛṣṭasya iti→nāstīty +asya · yathā cakṣur draṣṭṛ na bāhyena prakāśena vinā prakāśayatīty adraṣṭṛ na bhavati iti→prakāśayatīty +a · na ca vṛkṣavyatiriktaṃ vanaṃ yasmān nopalabhyate tato vanaṃ nāstīty avagamyate iti→nāstīty +avagamyate

kathaṃ punar asāv anartho hiṃsā hi sā sā ca pratiṣiddhā asāv+anartho · kathaṃ punar asāv anarthaḥ kartavyatayopadiśyata ucyate naiva śyenādayaḥ kartavyatayā vijñāyante asāv+anarthaḥ · nanv aśaktam idaṃ sūtram imāv arthāv abhivadituṃ codanālakṣaṇo dharmo nendriyādilakṣaṇo 'rthaś ca dharmo nānartha iti imāv+arthāv · nanv aśaktam idaṃ sūtram imāv arthāv abhivadituṃ codanālakṣaṇo dharmo nendriyādilakṣaṇo 'rthaś ca dharmo nānartha iti arthāv+abhivadituṃ

bhavitavyaṃ tu tena yasmin saty anantaraṃ dharmajijñāsāvakalpate anantaraṃ+dharma · api ca naiva vayam iha vedādhyayanāt pūrvaṃ dharmajijñāsāyāḥ pratiṣedhaṃ śiṣmaḥ pūrvaṃ+dharma · yady evaṃ na tarhi vedādhyayanaṃ pūrvaṃ dharmajijñāsāyāḥ pūrvaṃ+dharma · tasmād vedādhyayanam eva pūrvam abhinirvartyānantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity athaśabdasya sāmarthyam anantaram→abhinirvartyānantaraṃ +dharmo

kiṃ tu lakṣaṇayāsnānādiniyamasya paryavasānaṃ vedādhyayanasamakālam āhur vedam adhītya snāyād gurukulān mā samāvartiṣṭety adṛṣṭārthatāparihārāyaiva snāyād+guru · tasmād gaur iti gakārādivisarjanīyāntaṃ padam akṣarāṇy eva tasmād+gaur · upapattiś coparitanasya yo barhiṣi rajataṃ dadyāt purāsya saṃvatsarād gṛhe rodanaṃ bhavatīti saṃvatsarād+gṛhe · nindann eva ca dhanatyāge duḥkhadarśanāt purāsya saṃvatsarād gṛhe rodanaṃ bhavatīty āha saṃvatsarād+gṛhe

ataḥ pratyakṣam animittam ataḥ+pratyakṣam · ataḥ pūrvaṃ buddhir utpadyate paścāj jñāto 'rthaḥ ataḥ+pūrvaṃ · ataḥ pūrvaṃ buddhir utpadyate paścāj jñāto 'rthaḥ ataḥ+pūrvaṃ · atha śabde bruvati kathaṃ mithyeti na hi tadānīm anyataḥ puruṣād avagamaḥ anyataḥ+puruṣād

tatrānartho dharma ukto mā bhūd ity arthagrahaṇam ukto+mā · tadantargato doṣo mithyājñānasya hetuḥ doṣo+mithyājñānasya · athāpi gauṇaḥ syān na gauṇaḥ śabdo mā bhūd ity etāvatā pratyakṣādibhir anavagamyamāno 'rthaḥ śakyaḥ parikalpayitum śabdo+mā · na hy agnir māṇavaka ity ukte 'gniśabdo gauṇo mā bhūd iti jvalana eva māṇavaka ity adhyavasīyate gauṇo+mā

tasmād vedādhyayanam eva pūrvam abhinirvartyānantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity athaśabdasya sāmarthyam dharmo+jijñāsitavya · na brūmo 'nyasyāpi karmaṇo 'nantaraṃ dharmajijñāsā na kartavyeti kiṃ tu vedam adhītya tvaritena na snātavyam anantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity athaśabdasyārthaḥ dharmo+jijñāsitavya · evam adhīto vedo dharmajijñāsāyāṃ hetur jñāto 'nantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity ataḥśabdasya sāmarthyam dharmo+jijñāsitavya · tasmād dharmo jijñāsitavyaḥ dharmo+jijñāsitavyaḥ

ata etasmāt kāraṇād anantaraṃ dharmaṃ jijñāsitum icched ity ataḥśabdasyārthaḥ ata+etasmāt · āha kuta eṣaḥ saṃpratyayaḥ sukhādibhyo 'nyas tadvān astīti kuta+eṣaḥ · atha vijñānād anyo vijñātā nityas tata ekasmin ahani ya upalabdhāparedyur api sa evaiṣiṣyati tata+ekasmin · ata eva cānuvātaṃ dūrād upalabhyate śabdaḥ ata+eva

na ca svargakāmo yajetety ato vacanāt saṃdigdham avagamyate bhavati vā svargo na vā bhavatīti ato+vacanāt · na ca vṛkṣavyatiriktaṃ vanaṃ yasmān nopalabhyate tato vanaṃ nāstīty avagamyate tato+vanaṃ · yadi vane 'nyena hetunā sadbhāvaviparītaḥ pratyaya utpadyate mithyaiṣa vanapratyaya ity ato vanaṃ nāstīty avagacchāmaḥ ato+vanaṃ · ato vaiṣamyam ato+vaiṣamyam

yathā cakṣur draṣṭṛ na bāhyena prakāśena vinā prakāśayatīty adraṣṭṛ na bhavati cakṣur+draṣṭṛ · tad yāni vākyāni kriyāṃ nāvagamayanti kriyāsaṃbaddhaṃ vā kiṃcid evam eva bhūtam artham anvācakṣate ruditavān rudro vapām uccikheda prajāpatir devā vai diśo na prajajñira ityevaṃjātīyakāni tāni kaṃ dharmaṃ pramimīran prajāpatir+devā · tasmād dhūma evāgner divā dadṛśe nārciḥ agneḥ→evāgner +divā · dṛṣṭavirodha udāharaṇaṃ tasmād dhūma evāgner divā dadṛśe nārciḥ agneḥ→evāgner +divā

asaty apy arthāntara evaṃjātīyake bhavati pratyayaḥ paṅktir yūthaṃ vanam iti yatheti cen na paṅktir+yūthaṃ · na hi vismṛte vṛddhir ādaij ity asya sūtrasya kartari vṛddhir yasyācām ādis tad vṛddham iti kiṃcit pratīyeta vṛddhir+yasya · tad ucyate śarīrasaṃbandhād yasya tac charīraṃ so 'pi tair yajñāyudhair yajñāyudhīty ucyate tair+yajñāyudhair · tad ucyate śarīrasaṃbandhād yasya tac charīraṃ so 'pi tair yajñāyudhair yajñāyudhīty ucyate yajñāyudhair+yajña

kva puruṣaparatvaṃ kva vā puruṣo guṇabhūta ity etāsāṃ pratijñānāṃ piṇḍasya etat sūtram athāto dharmajijñāseti puruṣo+guṇa · atha gaur ity atra kaḥ śabdo gakāraukāravisarjanīyā iti bhagavān upavarṣaḥ śabdo+gakāra · na hy agnir māṇavaka ity ukte 'gniśabdo gauṇo mā bhūd iti jvalana eva māṇavaka ity adhyavasīyate śabdaḥ→'gniśabdo +gauṇo · na ca pratyakṣo gakārādibhyo 'nyo gośabda iti bhedadarśanābhāvād abhedadarśanāc ca pratyakṣo+gakāra

yo 'sau prāṇity apānity ucchvasiti nimiṣatītyādi ceṣṭitavān so 'tra śarīre yajñāyudhīti yajñāyudhī+iti→yajñāyudhīti · tasmāc charīraguṇavaidharmyād anyaḥ śarīrād yajñāyudhīti yajñāyudhī+iti→yajñāyudhīti · yasya saṃbandho 'py upalabhyate saṃbandhī ca tasyāyaṃ saṃbandhīti gamyate saṃbandhī+iti→saṃbandhīti · evaṃ cet sa eva yajñāyudhīti vyapadiśyate yajñāyudhī+iti→yajñāyudhīti

yasmiṃś ca nimittabhūte saty avabudhyate so 'vabodhayati yasmiṃś+ca · bhaviṣyaṃś caiṣo 'rtho na jñānakāle 'sti bhaviṣyaṃś+ca · pratipadyeraṃś cet prathamaśravaṇe 'pi pratipadyeran pratipadyeraṃś+cet · viśeṣān pratipattuṃ hi saṃjñāḥ kriyante viśeṣāṃś coddiśya viśeṣāṃś+ca

prāg bādhakajñānotpatteḥ katham avagamyate yadā na tatkāle samyagjñānasya mithyājñānasya ca kaścid viśeṣo yadā kṣudādibhir upahataṃ mano bhavatīndriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhir vā bāhyo viṣayas tato mithyājñānam anupahateṣu samyagjñānam tad+kāle→tatkāle · yatkālaṃ hi mardanaṃ tatkālaṃ mardanasukham yad+kālam→yatkālaṃ · yatkālaṃ hi mardanaṃ tatkālaṃ mardanasukham tad+kālam→tatkālaṃ · na hi saṃbandhavyatiriktaḥ kaścit kālo 'sti yasmin na kaścid api śabdaḥ kenacid arthena sambaddha āsīt kaścit+kālo

yo 'py anyapratyayaviparyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvātrāpi viparyasiṣyatīty ānumānikaḥ pratyaya utpadyate so 'py anena pratyakṣeṇa pratyayena virudhyamāno bādhyate 'py+anya · yo 'py anyapratyayaviparyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvātrāpi viparyasiṣyatīty ānumānikaḥ pratyaya utpadyate so 'py anena pratyakṣeṇa pratyayena virudhyamāno bādhyate 'py+anena · te 'pi vṛddhā yadā bālā āsaṃs tadānyebhyo vṛddhebhyas te 'py anyebhya iti nāsty ādir ity evaṃ vā bhavet 'py+anyebhya · tac ca draṣṭari vinaṣṭe 'py aparedyur utpadyamānaṃ nānupapannaṃ pratyakṣāvagatatvād eva 'py+aparedyur

tatra gurukulān mā samāvartiṣṭa kathaṃ nu vedavākyāni vicārayed ity evamartho 'yam upadeśaḥ kulāt→gurukulān +mā · kiṃ tu lakṣaṇayāsnānādiniyamasya paryavasānaṃ vedādhyayanasamakālam āhur vedam adhītya snāyād gurukulān mā samāvartiṣṭety adṛṣṭārthatāparihārāyaiva kulāt→gurukulān +mā · tasmān manyāmahe kenāpi puruṣeṇa śabdānām arthaiḥ saha saṃbandhaṃ kṛtvā saṃvyavahartuṃ vedāḥ praṇītā iti tasmān+manyāmahe · mṛdur ekena bahubhiś coccāryamāṇe tāny evākṣarāṇi karṇaśaṣkulīmaṇḍalasya sarvāṃ nemiṃ vyāpnuvadbhiḥ saṃyogavibhāgair nairantaryeṇānekaśo grahaṇān mahān ivāvayavavān ivopalabhyante grahaṇān+mahān

na kevalaṃ loke vede 'pi kevalaṃ+loke · pātracayanaṃ vidhāyāha sa eṣa yajñāyudhī yajamāno 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokaṃ yātīti pratyakṣaṃ śarīraṃ vyapadiśati svargaṃ+lokaṃ · na ca tat svargaṃ lokaṃ yāti svargaṃ+lokaṃ · yat tu pratyakṣaviruddhaṃ vacanam upanyastaṃ sa eṣa yajñāyudhī yajamāno 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokaṃ yātīti pratyakṣaṃ śarīraṃ vyapadiśatīti svargaṃ+lokaṃ

ucyate stambha iti jāgrato buddhiḥ supariniścitā kathaṃ viparyasiṣyati svapne 'py evam eva supariniścitāsīt prāk prabodhanāt jāgrato+buddhiḥ · pratyakṣā ca no buddhiḥ no+buddhiḥ · nirākārā tu no buddhir ākāravān bāhyo 'rthaḥ no+buddhir · yo 'py anyapratyayaviparyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvātrāpi viparyasiṣyatīty ānumānikaḥ pratyaya utpadyate so 'py anena pratyakṣeṇa pratyayena virudhyamāno bādhyate virudhyamāno+bādhyate

ata upapannaṃ jaiminivacanam ākṛtiḥ padārtha iti ata+upapannaṃ · na nūnam uparamanti saṃyogavibhāgā yata upalabhyate śabda iti yata+upalabhyate · atha na vinaṣṭas tato bahuśa upalabdhatvād arthāvagama iti yuktam bahuśa+upalabdha · gopiṇḍe ca bahūnām ākṛtīnāṃ sadbhāvāc chabdam antareṇa gośabdavācyāṃ vibhaktām ākṛtiṃ kena prakāreṇopadekṣyati nitye tu sati gośabde bahukṛtva uccaritaḥ śrutapūrvaś cānyāsu govyaktiṣv anvayavyatirekābhyām ākṛtivacanam avagamiṣyati kṛtvas→bahukṛtva +uccaritaḥ

na hi akṛtasaṃbandhāc chabdād arthaṃ pratipadyamānam upalabhāmahe saṃbandhāt→akṛtasaṃbandhāc +chabdād · tasmāc charīraguṇavaidharmyād anyaḥ śarīrād yajñāyudhīti tasmāc+śarīra · tasmāc chaśaviṣāṇavad asau nāsti tasmāc+śaśaviṣāṇa · yac ca nopalabhāmahe tac chaśaviṣāṇavad eva nāstīty avagacchāmaḥ tac+śaśaviṣāṇa

tatra ko dharmaḥ kathaṃlakṣaṇa ity ekenaiva sūtreṇa vyākhyātaṃ codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharma iti lakṣaṇaḥ+'rtho · tasmān na tāvan niścīyate codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharma iti lakṣaṇaḥ+'rtho · bhaviṣyaṃś caiṣo 'rtho na jñānakāle 'sti eṣaḥ+'rtho · tasmān na codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharmaḥ lakṣaṇaḥ+'rtho

anyato 'vagate 'rthe sūtram evamartham ity avagamyate tena caikadeśaḥ sūtryata iti sūtram anyato+'vagate · syād etad evaṃ naiva śabdasyārthenāsti saṃbandhaḥ kuto 'sya pauruṣeyatāpauruṣeyatā veti kuto+'sya · yadi saṃbandhur abhāvān niyogato nārthā upalabhyeraṃs tato 'rthāpattyā saṃbandhāram avagacchāmaḥ tato+'rthāpattyā · ye cāmī hyo 'dya ca na te vinaṣṭāḥ hyo+'dya

tasmāj jāgrataḥ pratyayo na mithyeti tasmāj+jāgrataḥ · ataḥ pūrvaṃ buddhir utpadyate paścāj jñāto 'rthaḥ paścāj+jñāto · ataḥ pūrvaṃ buddhir utpadyate paścāj jñāto 'rthaḥ paścāj+jñāto · bhavati hi kadācid etad yaj jñāto 'rthaḥ so 'jñāta ity ucyate yaj+jñāto

nanūtpannāyām eva buddhāv artho jñāta ity ucyate nānutpannāyām nanu+utpannāyām→nanūtpannāyām · itarathā tantūpādāne 'pi kadācid ghaṭabuddhir avikalendriyasya syāt tantu+upādāne→tantūpādāne · tad yathā pathi jāte 'rke madhūtsṛjya tenaiva pathā madhvarthinaḥ parvataṃ na gaccheyus tādṛśaṃ hi tat madhu+utsṛjya→madhūtsṛjya · nanūktaṃ phalavacanam iha gamyate na stutir iti nanu+uktam→nanūktaṃ

dṛṣṭā hi bālā vṛddhebhyaḥ pratipadyamānā na tv apratipannasaṃbandhāḥ saṃbandhasya kartuḥ pratipadyamānā+na · te ca vāyor apratyakṣatvāt saṃyogavibhāgā nopalabhyante vibhāgāḥ→saṃyogavibhāgā +na · api caikarūpye sati deśabhedena kāmaṃ deśā eva bhinnā na tu śabdaḥ bhinnā+na · saṃyogavibhāgā nairantaryeṇa kriyamāṇāḥ śabdam abhivyañjanto nādaśabdavācyāḥ vibhāgāḥ→saṃyogavibhāgā +nairantaryeṇa

evam adhīto vedo dharmajijñāsāyāṃ hetur jñāto 'nantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity ataḥśabdasya sāmarthyam vedo+dharma · sa punaḥ kathaṃ jijñāsitavyaḥ ko dharmaḥ kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ kāny asya sādhanāni kāni sādhanābhāsāni kiṃparaś ceti ko+dharmaḥ · tatra ko dharmaḥ kathaṃlakṣaṇa ity ekenaiva sūtreṇa vyākhyātaṃ codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharma iti ko+dharmaḥ · tatrānartho dharma ukto mā bhūd ity arthagrahaṇam anarthaḥ→tatrānartho +dharma

naivaṃjātīyakeṣv artheṣu puruṣavacanaṃ prāmāṇyam upaiti jātyandhānām iva vacanaṃ rūpaviśeṣeṣu vacanaṃ+rūpa · yathā ca kaścic cakṣuṣmān svayaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati na ca śaknoty anyasmai jātyandhāya tan nidarśayituṃ na ca tan na śakyate nidarśayitum ity etāvatā nāstīty avagamyata evam asau puruṣaḥ svayam ātmānam upalabhate na cānyasmai śaknoti darśayitum anyasya draṣṭus taṃ puruṣaṃ prati darśanaśaktyabhāvāt svayaṃ+rūpaṃ · kathaṃ roceta no 'nuṣṭhīyeteti kathaṃ+roceta · rodanaprabhavaṃ rajataṃ barhiṣi dadato rodanam āpadyate prabhavam→rodanaprabhavaṃ +rajataṃ

kuto 'nimittaṃ vidyamānopalambhanatvāt kuto+a · na cākṣaravyatirikto 'nyaḥ kaścid asti samudāyo nāma yato 'rthapratipattiḥ syāt yato+artha · ato gakārādivyatirikto 'nyo gośabdo 'sti yato 'rthapratipattiḥ syāt yato+artha · ato 'smaryamāṇo 'pi codanāyāḥ kartā syāt ato+a

pratyakṣaṃ hi tad dahyate tad+dahyate · no khalv apy etad dṛṣṭaṃ ya evānyedyur upalabdhā sa evāparedyur eṣiteti etad+dṛṣṭaṃ · tasmād darśanasya parārthatvān nityaḥ śabdaḥ tasmād+darśanasya · yad dvivacanabahuvacanasaṃyogaḥ yad+dvivacana

loke yeṣv artheṣu prasiddhāni padāni tāni sati sambhave tadarthāny eva sūtreṣv ity avagantavyam sūtreṣv+ity · bahavaḥ khalv iha janā asty ātmāsty ātmety ātmasattāvādina eva śabdasya pratyakṣavaktāro bhavanti tathāpi nātmasattāṃ kalpayituṃ ghaṭante kim aṅga punar jānātīti parokṣaśabdadarśanāt khalv+iha · yady asaṃśayaṃ nityaḥ śabdaḥ śabdaprayogaṃ kurv iti bhaviṣyati yathā gomayāt kurv iti saṃhāre kurv+iti · yady asaṃśayaṃ nityaḥ śabdaḥ śabdaprayogaṃ kurv iti bhaviṣyati yathā gomayāt kurv iti saṃhāre kurv+iti

na hy etad ekaṃ vākyaṃ purastāc ca vedādhyayanād dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhiṣyati parastāc cānantaryaṃ prakariṣyati adhyayanāt→vedādhyayanād +dharma · anyā hi vacanavyaktir asya purastād vedādhyayanād dharmajijñāsāṃ pratiṣedhato 'nyā ca parastād ānantaryam upadiśataḥ adhyayanāt→vedādhyayanād +dharma · tasmād dharmo jijñāsitavyaḥ tasmād+dharmo · tasmād dhūma evāgner divā dadṛśe nārciḥ tasmād+dhūma

tatra ko dharmaḥ kathaṃlakṣaṇa ity ekenaiva sūtreṇa vyākhyātaṃ codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharma iti 'rtho+dharma · tasmān na tāvan niścīyate codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharma iti 'rtho+dharma · tasmān na codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharmaḥ 'rtho+dharmaḥ · uktaṃ codanālakṣaṇo 'rtho dharma iti yato na puruṣakṛtaḥ śabdasyārthena saṃbandhaḥ 'rtho+dharma

aviyuktaḥ śabdārthayor bhāvaḥ saṃbandhena notpannayoḥ paścāt saṃbandhaḥ arthayoḥ→śabdārthayor +bhāvaḥ · na cādṛṣṭapūrve smṛtir bhavati smṛtir+bhavati · atrāpi brāhmaṇaṃ bhavaty atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃjyotir bhavatīti jyotiḥ→svayaṃjyotir +bhavati · yac caitad bahubhir bherīm ādhmanadbhiḥ śabdam uccārayadbhir mahāñ śabda upalabhyate tena pratipuruṣaṃ śabdāvayavapracaya iti gamyate bahubhir+bherīm

kutaḥ svabhāvato hy asaṃbandhāv etau śabdārthau kutaḥ+svabhāvato · kutaḥ svayaṃjyotiṣṭvavacanāt kutaḥ+svayam · yaḥ svayaṃ paśyati na tato 'nyaḥ puruṣa ity etad api puruṣapravṛttyānumīyate yadāsau puruṣaḥ pūrvedyuḥ sāmikṛtānām arthānāṃ pratisamādhāne śeṣānuṣṭhāne ca yatate 'taḥ pravṛttyāvagamyate nūnam asāv anityān nityam avagacchatīti pūrvedyuḥ+sāmi · ataḥ svayam avagamyamānatvād asti tadvyatiriktaḥ puruṣa iti ataḥ+svayam

yathā cākṛtiḥ śabdārthas tathopariṣṭān nipuṇataram upapādayiṣyāma iti tathā+upariṣṭāt→tathopariṣṭān · na hi candramasam ādityaṃ vopalabhya saṃbandhyantarānveṣaṇā bhavati kasyāyam iti vā+upalabhya→vopalabhya · na ca śakyam evam avagantuṃ yathopalabhyante 'rthā na tathā bhavanti yathā na khalu nopalabhyante tathā bhavantīti yathā+upalabhyante→yathopalabhyante · na ca sādṛśyamātraṃ dṛṣṭvā prakṛtir vikṛtir vocyate vā+ucyate→vocyate

pratyagātmani caitad bhavati na paratra etat→caitad +bhavati · yathā gāvīśabdāt sāsnādim iti pratyayasyānivṛttis tadvad bhaviṣyatīti cet tadvad+bhaviṣyati · yatra kevalaḥ padārthaḥ prayujyamānaḥ prayojanābhāvād anarthakaḥ saṃjāyata ity avagataṃ bhavati tatra vākyārtho 'pi tāvad bhavatv iti viśiṣṭārthatāvagamyate na sarvatra tāvad+bhavatv · vākyaṃ hi saṃbandhasya vidhāyakaṃ dvau cet saṃbandhau vidadhyād bhūtikāma ālabhetālambhena caiṣa guṇo bhaviṣyatīti bhidyeta tarhy evaṃ sati vākyam vidadhyād+bhūti

vākyāddhi prathamāvagatād api pratiyanto 'rthaṃ dṛśyante vākyāt+hi→vākyāddhi · etaddhi kriyata ity ucyate etat+hi→etaddhi · taddhi nirdiśyate yasmāt sūrpeṇānnaṃ kriyate tasmāt sūrpeṇa juhotīti tat+hi→taddhi · tasmāddhetuvan nigadasyāpi stutir eva kāryam iti tasmāt+hetu→tasmāddhetuvan

so 'rodīd yad arodīt tad rudrasya rudratvaṃ prajāpatir ātmano vapām udakhidat tad+rudrasya · devā vai devayajanakāle diśo na prajñātavanto 'to 'nyo 'pi diśo na prajānīyād iti tac cāśakyam iṣṭaviyogenābhighātena vā yad bāṣpanirmocanaṃ tad rodanam ity ucyate na ca tad icchāto bhavati tad+rodanam · so 'rodīd yad arodīt tad rudrasya rudratvam ity atra sa iti prakṛtāpekṣas tatpratyayāt tad+rudrasya · liṅgād raśanāmātre śabdāt tu viśeṣe 'śvābhidhānyām iti liṅgād+raśanā

evam adhīto vedo dharmajijñāsāyāṃ hetur jñāto 'nantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity ataḥśabdasya sāmarthyam hetur+jñāto · satīndriyārthasaṃbandhe yā puruṣasya buddhir jāyate tat pratyakṣam buddhir+jāyate · ucyate 'prākṛtasya bahoḥ karmasamūhasyopasthitatvād gauṇo mohaśabdo 'vadhāraṇāvakāśadānādibhir jñāpayatīti gauṇatā ādibhiḥ→'vadhāraṇāvakāśadānādibhir +jñāpayati · tasmād arcir evāgner naktaṃ dadṛśe na dhūma iti agnir jyotir jyotir agniḥ svāheti sāyaṃ juhoti sūryo jyotir jyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāheti prātar iti miśraliṅgamantrayor vidhānasyākāṅkṣitatvāc cheṣaḥ agnir+jyotir

dhūmo lakṣaṇam agner iti hi vadanti dhūmo+lakṣaṇam · tayā yo lakṣyate so 'rthaḥ puruṣaṃ niḥśreyasena saṃyunaktīti pratijānīmahe yo+lakṣyate · yaś ca yasya kartā sa tena vyapadiśyate yathā pācako lāvaka iti pācako+lāvaka · ikārasādṛśyaṃ ca yakārasyopalabhyate tenāpi tayoḥ prakṛtivikārabhāvo lakṣyate bhāvaḥ→prakṛtivikārabhāvo +lakṣyate

bravītīty ucyate 'vabodhayati budhyamānasya nimittaṃ bhavatīti iti→bravītīty +ucyate · bravītīty ucyate 'vabodhayati budhyamānasya nimittam bhavatīti iti→bravītīty +ucyate · nanu ca śāstrakārā apy evam āhuḥ pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvam ākhyāte nācaṣṭe vrajati pacatīty upakramaprabhṛty apavargaparyantam iti yathā iti→pacatīty +upakrama · atrocyate yadi vijñānād anyo vijñātā nāsti kas tarhi jānātīty ucyate jñānasya kartur abhidhānam anena śabdenopapadyate iti→jānātīty +ucyate

tatra bhinnayor eva vākyayor imāv ekadeśāv ity avagantavyam imāv+eka · kutaḥ svabhāvato hy asaṃbandhāv etau śabdārthau saṃbandhau→asaṃbandhāv +etau · tac ca saṃyogavibhāgasadbhāve sati bhavatīti saṃyogavibhāgāv evābhivyañjakāv iti vakṣyāmaḥ vibhāgau→saṃyogavibhāgāv +eva · sa bahuśākhādhyāyināṃ saṃnidhāv ekaśākhādhyāyy anyāṃ śākhām anadhīyānas tasyāṃ prakṛṣṭatvād asādhāraṇam upapadyate viśeṣaṇam saṃnidhāv+eka

tatra bhinnayor eva vākyayor imāv ekadeśāv ity avagantavyam deśau→ekadeśāv +ity · tac ca saṃyogavibhāgasadbhāve sati bhavatīti saṃyogavibhāgāv evābhivyañjakāv iti vakṣyāmaḥ abhivyañjakau→evābhivyañjakāv +iti · na ced upakurvanti tasmād animittaṃ śabdopalambhane saṃyogavibhāgāv iti vibhāgau→saṃyogavibhāgāv +iti · kathaṃ tarhy ālabheta yatas tato bhūtir iti bhinnāv imāv arthāv ubhayābhidhāne vākyaṃ bhidyeta bhinnāv+imāv

kathaṃ jñāyate yadā hi śuktikāyām api rajataṃ manyamāno rajatasaṃnikṛṣṭaṃ me cakṣur iti manyate bādhakaṃ hi yatra jñānam utpadyate naitad evaṃ mithyājñānam idam iti tad anyasaṃprayoge viparītaṃ tatsaṃprayoga iti manyamāno+rajata · asmāl lokād utkramyāgnir ādityaṃ gato rātrāv ādityastam ity etad upapādayitum idam ubhayam api dṛṣṭaviruddham ucyate gato+rātrāv · rodanaprabhavaṃ rajataṃ barhiṣi dadato rodanam āpadyate dadato+rodanam · eko rudro na dvitīyo 'vatasthe eko+rudro
ataś ca tat pramāṇam anapekṣatvāt ataś+ca · itaś ca paśyāmaḥ stutir iti itaś+ca · tataś cāvyāmohe ca tasminn aśakyā śrutiḥ kalpayitum tataś+ca · ataś ca sarvaveṣṭanādi nādaraṇīyam ataś+ca

yac caitad bahubhir bherīm ādhmanadbhiḥ śabdam uccārayadbhir mahāñ śabda upalabhyate tena pratipuruṣaṃ śabdāvayavapracaya iti gamyate etat→caitad +bahubhir · syād etad buddhikarmaṇī api te pratyabhijñāyete etad+buddhi · devā vai devayajanakāle diśo na prajñātavanto 'to 'nyo 'pi diśo na prajānīyād iti tac cāśakyam iṣṭaviyogenābhighātena vā yad bāṣpanirmocanaṃ tad rodanam ity ucyate na ca tad icchāto bhavati yad+bāṣpa · tasmād barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyam ity asya tasmād+barhiṣi

na gamyamāne 'rthe 'vivakṣitārthāni bhavitum arhanti a+vivakṣita→'vivakṣitārthāni · adhyāyānadhyāyate gurumukhāt pratipattiḥ śiṣyopādhyāyatā ca sarvasminn evaṃjātīyake 'vighnārthe tulyam ādriyante a+vighna→'vighnārthe · api ca nigamādibhir arthe kalpayamāne 'vyavasthitaḥ śabdārtho bhavet tatrāniścayaḥ syāt a+vyavasthitaḥ→'vyavasthitaḥ · kim atraikaḥ śabdo 'vicchinnapāramparyo 'rthābhidhāyītare 'pabhraṃśā uta sarve 'nādayaḥ a+vicchinna→'vicchinnapāramparyo

yathā vetasaśākhayāvakābhiś cāgniṃ vikarṣatīti vetasāvake vidhīyete āpaś ca stūyanta āpo vai śāntā iti stūyanta+āpo · tām agnau prāgṛhṇād vaidyuta ārcīse laukike vā vaidyuta+ārcīse · yadi te 'gniprayojanās tatas ta āgneyā nāgniśabdasaṃnidhānāt ta+āgneyā · ye 'pi śyāmā bṛhanto lohitākṣās te 'pi na sarva āhnīnaibukādīn kurvate sarva+āhnīnaibuka

lakṣaṇayā tu stutir gamyate stutir+gamyate · nātra vidhir gamyate vartamānakālapratyayanirdeśāt vidhir+gamyate · gaur gāvī goṇī gopotalikā ityevamādayaḥ śabdā udāharaṇam gaur+gāvī · kasyacit kiṃcit prādhānyena vivakṣitaṃ bhavati tenātrākṛtir guṇabhāvena vyaktiḥ pradhānabhāvena vivakṣyata iti ākṛtiḥ→tenātrākṛtir +guṇa

athedānīṃ kim vivakṣitavacanā mantrā utāvivakṣitavacanāḥ vacanāḥ→vivakṣitavacanā +mantrā · tathābhyādānasamarthā mantrā udāharaṇam samarthāḥ→tathābhyādānasamarthā +mantrā · tasmān na vivakṣitavacanā mantrāḥ vacanāḥ→vivakṣitavacanā +mantrāḥ · tasmād uccāraṇārthā mantrāḥ arthāḥ→uccāraṇārthā +mantrāḥ

evam adhīto vedo dharmajijñāsāyāṃ hetur jñāto 'nantaraṃ dharmo jijñāsitavya ity ataḥśabdasya sāmarthyam atas+śabdasya→ataḥśabdasya · ata etasmāt kāraṇād anantaraṃ dharmaṃ jijñāsitum icched ity ataḥśabdasyārthaḥ atas+śabdasya→ataḥśabdasyārthaḥ · yāvatkṛtvaḥ śrutād arthāvagamaḥ yāvatkṛtvaḥ+śrutād · śabdenāpi pramīyate tataḥ śabdo 'pi pramāṇaṃ yathaiva pratyakṣam tataḥ+śabdo

upadiṣṭavantaś ca manvādayaḥ manu+ādayaḥ→manvādayaḥ · upalambhanāni cendriyāṇi paśvādīnām paśu+ādīnām→paśvādīnām · nanv ākṛtiḥ sādhyāsti vā na veti na pratyakṣā satī sādhyā bhavitum arhati nanv+ākṛtiḥ · yasya punaḥ kurvanti tasya vāyavīyāḥ saṃyogavibhāgā vāyvāśritatvād vāyuṣv eva kariṣyanti yathā tantavas tantuṣv eva paṭam vāyu+āśrita→vāyvāśritatvād

anumānaṃ jñātasaṃbandhasya ekadeśadarśanād ekadeśāntare 'saṃnikṛṣṭe 'rthe buddhiḥ a+saṃnikṛṣṭe→'saṃnikṛṣṭe · vane 'pi te 'sati vanapratyayaḥ prāpnotīti a+sati→'sati · evam api prakṛtaṃ dūṣayitum aśaknuvantas te siddhāntāntaradūṣaṇaṃ nigrahasthānam āpadyate 'sādhakatvāt a+sādhaka→'sādhakatvāt · ucyate 'sadvṛttāntānvākhyānaṃ stutyarthena praśaṃsāyā gamyamānatvāt a+sat→'sadvṛttāntānvākhyānaṃ

yo 'py anyapratyayaviparyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvātrāpi viparyasiṣyatīty ānumānikaḥ pratyaya utpadyate so 'py anena pratyakṣeṇa pratyayena virudhyamāno bādhyate yo+'py · yo 'py anyapratyayaviparyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvātrāpi viparyasiṣyatīty ānumānikaḥ pratyaya utpadyate so 'py anena pratyakṣeṇa pratyayena virudhyamāno bādhyate so+'py · yasya saṃbandho 'py upalabhyate saṃbandhī ca tasyāyaṃ saṃbandhīti gamyate saṃbandho+'py · so 'py anyaḥ puruṣaḥ svayam ātmānam upalabhate na parātmānam so+'py

ato gakārādivyatirikto 'nyo gośabdo 'sti yato 'rthapratipattiḥ syāt vyatiriktaḥ+'nyo · na ca pratyakṣo gakārādibhyo 'nyo gośabda iti bhedadarśanābhāvād abhedadarśanāc ca ādibhyaḥ+'nyo · tasmān na sukhādivyatirikto 'nyo 'stīti vyatiriktaḥ+'nyo · tasmāt tadvyatirikto 'nyo 'sti yatrāyam ahaṃśabdaḥ vyatiriktaḥ+'nyo

na hy agnir māṇavaka ity ukte 'gniśabdo gauṇo mā bhūd iti jvalana eva māṇavaka ity adhyavasīyate agnir+māṇavaka · api ca bahubhir uccārayadbhir mahān śabdaḥ śrūyate uccārayadbhir+mahān · yac caitad bahubhir bherīm ādhmanadbhiḥ śabdam uccārayadbhir mahāñ śabda upalabhyate tena pratipuruṣaṃ śabdāvayavapracaya iti gamyate uccārayadbhir+mahāñ · agnirmūrdhā diva iti na viparyayeṇa agniḥ+mūrdhā→agnirmūrdhā

te 'pi vṛddhā yadā bālā āsaṃs tadānyebhyo vṛddhebhyas te 'py anyebhya iti nāsty ādir ity evaṃ vā bhavet vṛddhā+yadā · na nūnam uparamanti saṃyogavibhāgā yata upalabhyate śabda iti vibhāgāḥ→saṃyogavibhāgā +yata · ṛtvijo vṛṇīte vṛtā yajanti devayajanam adhyavasyantīti vṛtā+yajanti · yadā ta eva tadāpi kiṃ ta evaiṣām arthā ye loka utānya iti saṃśayaḥ arthā+ye

yasya saṃbandho 'py upalabhyate saṃbandhī ca tasyāyaṃ saṃbandhīti gamyate 'py+upalabhyate · yadi śabdaṃ saṃyogavibhāgā evābhivyañjanti na kurvanty ākāśaviṣayatvāc chabdasyākāśasyaikatvād ya evāyam atra śrotrākāśaḥ sa eva deśāntareṣv apīti śrughnasthaiḥ saṃyogavibhāgair abhivyaktaḥ pāṭaliputre 'py upalabhyeta 'py+upalabhyeta · uccikhedātmavapāṃ prajāpatir ato 'nyo 'py utkhided ātmano vapām 'py+utkhided · atha nūccāraṇaviśeṣārthā buddhe 'py uccāraṇaviśeṣo 'vakalpyeteti 'py+uccāraṇa

bhavati cānyedyur upalabdhe 'paredyur icchā anyedyus→cānyedyur +upalabdhe · no khalv apy etad dṛṣṭaṃ ya evānyedyur upalabdhā sa evāparedyur eṣiteti anyedyus→evānyedyur +upalabdhā · tac ca draṣṭari vinaṣṭe 'py aparedyur utpadyamānaṃ nānupapannaṃ pratyakṣāvagatatvād eva aparedyur+utpadyamānaṃ · pratīmo hi vayam imam arthaṃ vayam evānyedyur upalabhāmahe vayam evādya smarāma iti anyedyus→evānyedyur +upalabhāmahe

sa vā ayam ātmeti prakṛtyāmananty aśīryo na hi śīryata iti vā+ayam · tathāvināśī vā are 'yam ātmānucchittidharmā iti vā+are · atha yad uktaṃ vijñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tāny evānuvinaśyati na pretya saṃjñāstīty atrocyate 'traiva mā bhagavān mohāntam āpīpadad iti paricodanottarakāle 'pahnutya mohāntābhiprāyam asya vacanasya varṇitavān na vā are 'haṃ mohaṃ bravīmy avināśī vā are 'yam ātmānucchittidharmā mātrāsaṃsargas tv asya bhavatīti vā+are · atha yad uktaṃ vijñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tāny evānuvinaśyati na pretya saṃjñāstīty atrocyate 'traiva mā bhagavān mohāntam āpīpadad iti paricodanottarakāle 'pahnutya mohāntābhiprāyam asya vacanasya varṇitavān na vā are 'haṃ mohaṃ bravīmy avināśī vā are 'yam ātmānucchittidharmā mātrāsaṃsargas tv asya bhavatīti vā+are

pṛthivyādīnāṃ nindā hiraṇyastutyarthā pṛthivī+ādīnām→pṛthivyādīnāṃ · pratīyate hi gāvyādibhyaḥ sāsnādimān arthaḥ gāvī+ādibhyaḥ→gāvyādibhyaḥ · tena gāvyādibhyaḥ sāsnādimān avagamyate gāvī+ādibhyaḥ→gāvyādibhyaḥ · anurūpo hi gāvyādigośabdasya gāvī+ādi→gāvyādigośabdasya

iha ye vidhivan nigadā arthavādās te udāharaṇam audumbaro yūpo bhavaty ūrg vā uduṃbara ūrk paśava ūrjair vāsmā ūrjaṃ paśūn nāpnoti ūrjo 'varuddhyā iti 'varuddhyā+iti · api ca ūrjo 'varuddhyā iti prayojanaṃ śrūyate 'varuddhyā+iti · ūrjo 'varuddhyā ity aprasiddhaṃ vacanam 'varuddhyā+ity · audumbaro yūpo bhavatīti vidhāv etasminn āśrīyamāṇe ūrjo 'varuddhyā ity etasmiṃś ca vākyaṃ bhidyeta 'varuddhyā+ity

dharmaṃ prati hi vipratipannā bahuvidaḥ vipratipannā+bahu · syād etad aprasiddhasaṃbandhā bālāḥ kathaṃ vṛddhebhyaḥ pratipadyanta iti saṃbandhāḥ→aprasiddhasaṃbandhā +bālāḥ · atha nūccāraṇaviśeṣārthā buddhe 'py uccāraṇaviśeṣo 'vakalpyeteti arthāḥ→nūccāraṇaviśeṣārthā +buddhe · ye 'pi śyāmā bṛhanto lohitākṣās te 'pi na sarva āhnīnaibukādīn kurvate śyāmā+bṛhanto
